_doc: Source mapping for every jar the tuxmine packs add on top of stock GTNH (read by tuxmine_extras.py).
Each entry matches jar file names with the regex `jar` (full match). Its named group `version` is the version
the tag is derived from. Every tuxmine jar must match exactly one entry, or the tool fails.
kind: git        checkout of `repo` at `tag` (a template over the jar version, checked with git ls-remote),
or at a pinned `commit` on `branch`, which is only valid for `verified_version`.
this-repo  a snapshot of `subdir` of this repository at the commit that built the shipped version.
covered    already in gtnh-src/source/ as the GTNH manifest row with modId `covered_modId`; its `ref`
skip       not sourced on purpose; `reason` is required and is printed in the indexes.
Optional: dir (checkout dir name, default: the repo name), name, ours (one of the owner's own mods),
submodules {path: {repo, branch, commit, note}}, bundles [{name, repo, tag, runtimePackage, note}],
decompile {include: [class path prefixes]}, notes, generated [classes the build generates, so they are
not in the source; the generateGradleTokenClass of gradle.properties is detected without this].

The Forge 1.7.10 host mod. The core-java8 and font-adapter-java8 jars next to it are separate libraries from the Qz-UILib-Core and Qz-UILib-Platform repos (same version tag).

mods.name: Qz UILib core (Java 8 library jar)
mods.notes: Platform-free UI core library (Maven asia.quanhuzeyu.uilib:core:<version>:java8), no mcmod.info. Qz-UILib pulls it in from Maven; its source is the separate Qz-UILib-Core repo at the same version tag.

mods.name: Qz UILib font adapter (Java 8 library jar)
mods.notes: Font adapter library (Maven asia.quanhuzeyu.uilib:font-adapter:<version>:java8), no mcmod.info. Its source is the Qz-UILib-Platform repo (font, render, media and desktop adapters) at the same version tag.

Dave's own mod, from this repository. The release commit is found from a davebridge-v<version> tag, else the commit whose subject names "DaveBridge <version>", cross-checked against the commit that added the jar to a tuxmine pack, and verified against the jar's class list and lang file.

mods.name: DiscordIntegration (unofficial 1.7.10 build)

core.note: The fork pins core at c7385b932d58fffac6c2ad82fbbfa9e694d38227, which was never published (not in Chikachi/DiscordIntegrationCore or any fork of it). This is upstream master (code last changed 2018-06-29); its 61 top-level classes match the jar's class list exactly, but the bodies may differ where the fork adapted core to JDA 3.8.3. The decompile in mods/ is authoritative for chikachi.discord.core.

bundles.name: JDA
bundles.note: Java Discord API 3.8.3 (CI build 464), shaded into the DiscordIntegration jar and relocated from net.dv8tion.jda to chikachi.discord.repack.net.dv8tion.jda. Use it to read the message-sending API (TextChannel.sendMessage(...).queue()).

mods.notes: Unofficial 1.7.10 build 3.1.1 of Chikachi's DiscordIntegration by Miradae (co-author in mcmod.info), CurseForge file 3147365. Miradae's fork, branch v3/mc1.7, head commit 4fde366 (2020-12-23, "updated jda to 3.8.3_464") has modVersion 3.1.1, jdaVersion 3.8.3 and jdaJob 464 in build.gradle, which is exactly the jar version. Chikachi's own 1.7 line stops at 3.0.5. The mod's own classes (chikachi.discord.*, chikachi.discord.core.*) were also decompiled into mods/ because the core submodule commit is unpublished. Sending to Discord: chikachi.discord.core.DiscordClient (getInstance(), broadcast(...)) and the JDA bundle.
